comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Item 0 is 1 if any comment asserts the OP's claim or a stated proposition is false or logically invalid, with a carve-out for comments that only quantify systemic harm. Item 1 is 1 if any comment quotes the OP's title or argument text verbatim, as a blockquote or in quotation marks, whether or not it endorses or refutes it. A comment can assert falsity without quoting, and can quote without asserting falsity. The eligibility rules and null handling also differ.
